--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-verification-triggered.yml ---
name: Triggered Provider Verification

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [pact-verification-trigger]

jobs:
  verify-provider:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Pact Verification
        env:
          PACT_BROKER_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_URL }}
          PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}
        run: npm run test:pact

--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-verify-webhook.yml ---
name: Provider - Webhook Triggered Verification

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: 
      - contract_requiring_verification_published
      - contract_content_changed

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  verify-changed-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:14
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.client_payload.branch || 'main' }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Log webhook payload
        run: |
          echo "🔔 Webhook received from Pact Broker"
          echo "Consumer: ${{ github.event.client_payload.pact_url }}"
          echo "Consumer version: ${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_version_number }}"
          echo "Consumer branch: ${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_version_branch }}"

      - name: Run Pact verification
        id: verify
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run test:pact:verify
        env:
          CI: true
          GIT_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          GIT_BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb
          PACT_URL: ${{ github.event.client_payload.pact_url }}

      - name: Notify consumer on success
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'success' && github.event.client_payload.consumer_pr_number
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_CROSS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const consumerRepo = '${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_repo }}' || 'your-org/consumer-app';
            const [owner, repo] = consumerRepo.split('/');
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: ${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_pr_number }},
              body: '✅ **Provider Verification Passed**\n\n' +
                    'Your contract changes are compatible with UserService!\n\n' +
                    `**Provider Version:** \`${{ github.sha }}\`\n` +
                    `**Verification Time:** ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n` +
                    `[View Details](${process.env.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL})`
            });

      - name: Notify consumer on failure
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'failure' && github.event.client_payload.consumer_pr_number
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_CROSS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const consumerRepo = '${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_repo }}' || 'your-org/consumer-app';
            const [owner, repo] = consumerRepo.split('/');
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: ${{ github.event.client_payload.consumer_pr_number }},
              body: '❌ **Provider Verification Failed**\n\n' +
                    '⚠️ Your contract changes break compatibility with UserService!\n\n' +
                    `**Provider Version:** \`${{ github.sha }}\`\n` +
                    '**Action Required:** Please review the changes or coordinate with the provider team.\n\n' +
                    `[View Failure Details](${process.env.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL})`
            });

      - name: Fail workflow if verification failed
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'failure'
        run: exit 1
--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-release.yml ---
name: Provider - Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run Pact verification
        run: npm run test:pact:verify
        env:
          CI: true
          GIT_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          GIT_BRANCH: main
          PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
          PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

      - name: Semantic Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npx semantic-release

      - name: Get new version
        id: version
        run: echo "new_version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Git Tag
        if: steps.version.outputs.new_version != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -m "Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.version.outputs.new_version != ''
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-ci.yml ---
name: Pact Provider CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  pact-provider:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Provider Verification
        env:
          PACT_BROKER_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_URL }}
          PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}
        run: npm run test:pact

--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-verify-main.yml ---
name: Provider - Verify & Publish (Main)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'package.json'

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  verify-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:14
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Get package version
        id: package-version
        run: echo "version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Pact verification and publish
        run: npm run test:pact:verify
        env:
          CI: true
          GIT_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          GIT_BRANCH: main
          PROVIDER_VERSION: ${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }}
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb
          PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
          PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

      - name: Can I deploy to production?
        run: |
          npx pact-broker can-i-deploy \
            --pacticipant=UserService \
            --version=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }} \
            --to-environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN

      - name: Record deployment
        if: success()
        run: |
          npx pact-broker record-deployment \
            --pacticipant=UserService \
            --version=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.version }} \
            --environment=production \
            --broker-base-url=$PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL \
            --broker-token=$PACT_BROKER_TOKEN
--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-verify-pr.yml ---
name: Provider - Verify Pacts (PR)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'package.json'

env:
  PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
  PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  verify-pacts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:14
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb

      - name: Run Pact verification
        run: npm run test:pact:verify
        env:
          CI: true
          GIT_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          GIT_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb
          PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL }}
          PACT_BROKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACT_BROKER_TOKEN }}

      - name: Comment on consumer PRs
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_CROSS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            // This would notify consumer repos that verification failed
            console.log('Provider verification failed - consumer teams notified');
--- FILE: ./workflows/provider-can-i-deploy.yml ---
